text_block_list.text: I have triumphed. Just as I expected.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. As I said, I paced myself for
a
2,000-meter race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If today's performance is any indication,
our next
race should pose little
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
At long last, we can begin conquering
the Classic
Triple Crown with our first
objective...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho awaits us.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Just as we solidify our resolve to enter
the Satsuki
Sho...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: President, um...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you again. What did you think of
my
performance?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You were amazing... and so confident!
You're way
above the rest of us...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text: Hm? Now, don't—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Sorry! I-I didn't mean... That is... I should
be
going!
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text: Dash...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. I'll speak with her
later.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Right now, we should review today's
performance.
Time is money, as they say,
and it would not do
to waste it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф and I put our heads
together for a
while and review her race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Just as we arrive back at the academy...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM! Screeeeech!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm? An engine this loud could only
mean...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Heya, Rudolf!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Марузенски. Just as I thought.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A little birdie told me you're finally
going for the
Classic Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's one gnarly goal! I hope you pull it
off! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's Марузенски the Beast, the so-called
"Hot
Rod" who has taken the world by
storm, and
made her debut even earlier
than Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the Emperor on one side and the
Beast on
the other, it's hard to hide my
excitement as a
trainer. And yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gnarly... hmmm. Perhaps... no, that's not
funny
enough.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You're not trying to turn that into a pun,
are you?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: You could pull a muscle doing that.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be a worthy
challenge... as well
as a potent addition
to my arsenal if I could pull
it off.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Hey, not cool! You can't just take the
things I say
and turn them into gags!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Haha... My apologies.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The two seem like they're on good
terms. I can't
help but notice that
Симболи Рудольф looks a little
more
relaxed in Марузенски's company.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, shoot! Gotta dash! I'm keeping the
teacher
waiting!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I think the school found out about me
using an
employee parking spot.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's not like anyone else was
using it!
What's the problem, right?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Are you certain you want to ask the
president of
the student council? You
might not like the
answer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Aw, man... Why do you have to be such
a square?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Guess I'd better be going. Hasta la vista,
baby!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Haha... As energetic as ever.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I see her as less of a friend and more as...
an
object of interest, one might say.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As you are surely aware, her effortless
strength is
causing quite the stir in the
racing world.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I regard her as a worthy contributor to
the future I
mean to build.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: And besides, I find her... intriguing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: She stirs my most basic racing instincts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I think of myself as drawing strength
from many
things. My dreams, my ideals,
the expectations of
the students I lead.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But I cannot help but wonder... if I were
to meet
her on the track, fueled only by
my thirst for
victory, who would prevail?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Which of us would truly prove the
strongest?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
For just an instant, something shines in
her eyes,
but it quickly fades.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I have a long way to go before I'm
qualified
to speak of such things.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now then, I ought to get back to work.
I'm going
to return to the academy. How
about you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But of course. There is always more to
be done. If
that is all, then I will take my
leave.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If she were to race against Марузенски
as she is
now—a racer pursuing an
ideal—she would
undoubtedly compete
as the "Emperor."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But after today, a part of me hopes that
someday
she has the chance to compete
simply as Symboli
Rudolf instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
